user.title: Climate Advisor Setup
user.description: Configure your Climate Advisor integration. Select the entities it should monitor and control.

data_description.weather_entity: The weather integration Climate Advisor uses for forecasts and outdoor conditions.
data_description.climate_entity: The thermostat Climate Advisor will monitor and control.
data_description.notify_service: The Home Assistant notify service for alerts and daily briefings (e.g. notify.mobile_app_yourphone).

unit.title: Temperature Unit
unit.description: Choose the unit Climate Advisor uses for every temperature you see and enter. You can change it later in Core Settings.

data_description.temp_unit: Used for every temperature shown and entered in Climate Advisor. You can change it later in Core Settings; a reload is then needed and Climate Advisor will prompt you.

setpoints.title: Temperature Setpoints
setpoints.description: Set your comfort, away, and sleep temperature targets.

data_description.comfort_heat: Target temperature when heating and someone is home.
data_description.comfort_cool: Target temperature when cooling and someone is home.
data_description.setback_heat: Lower temperature used when away from home to save energy.
data_description.setback_cool: Higher temperature used when away from home to save energy.
data_description.sleep_heat: Target temperature when heating during sleep hours (when home).
data_description.sleep_cool: Target temperature when cooling during sleep hours (when home).

temperature_sources.title: Temperature Sources
temperature_sources.description: Choose where Climate Advisor reads outdoor and indoor temperature data from.

data_description.outdoor_temp_source: Where to read outside temperature. 'Weather service' uses your weather integration; a dedicated sensor or input helper lets you use a specific entity.
data_description.indoor_temp_source: Where to read inside temperature. 'Climate entity' uses your thermostat's built-in sensor; a dedicated sensor or input helper lets you use a separate entity.

outdoor_temp_entity.title: Outdoor Temperature Entity
outdoor_temp_entity.description: Select the entity that provides outdoor temperature readings.

data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Choose the sensor or input helper that reports outdoor temperature.

indoor_temp_entity.title: Indoor Temperature Entity
indoor_temp_entity.description: Select the entity that provides indoor temperature readings.

data_description.indoor_temp_entity: Choose the sensor or input helper that reports indoor temperature.

sensors.title: Door & Window Sensors
sensors.description:
Select binary sensors that Climate Advisor should monitor. When a sensor indicates a door or window is open, HVAC will be paused to avoid wasting energy.

You can select individual sensors or a binary sensor group entity that bundles multiple sensors together.

The polarity toggle controls how sensor states are interpreted. Most sensors use the Home Assistant standard where 'on' means open (unsafe). If your sensors report the opposite, enable the invert toggle.

data_description.door_window_sensors: Select any binary sensor entities to monitor, including binary sensor groups that bundle multiple sensors together.
data_description.sensor_polarity_inverted: Enable this if your sensors report 'on' when closed and 'off' when open, which is the opposite of the Home Assistant standard.
data_description.fan_mode: How to control fans for ventilation. 'Whole house fan' controls a dedicated fan entity. 'HVAC fan' uses the thermostat fan mode.
data_description.fan_entity: The fan or switch entity to control (only needed for whole house fan mode).

occupancy.title: Occupancy Awareness
occupancy.description: Configure toggle entities that tell Climate Advisor who is home. All fields are optional — leave blank if you don't use that feature.

data_description.home_toggle_entity: An entity (input_boolean, switch, etc.) that indicates whether someone is home. ON = home, OFF = away.
data_description.home_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're away and OFF when you're home.
data_description.vacation_toggle_entity: An entity that indicates vacation mode. When active, a deeper temperature setback is applied for extended energy savings.
data_description.vacation_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're NOT on vacation.
data_description.guest_toggle_entity: An entity that indicates guests are present. Overrides vacation and away modes — comfort temperature is maintained.
data_description.guest_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when guests are NOT present.

schedule.title: Daily Schedule
schedule.description: Set your household schedule so Climate Advisor knows when to warm up, cool down, and send briefings.

data_description.zone_name: A short name for this zone (e.g. "Bedroom"). Shown in Settings → Devices & Services and in the dashboard zone selector. Suggested from your climate entity's name — edit as you like.
data_description.wake_time: When your household typically wakes up. Climate Advisor starts warming or cooling to your comfort temperature before this time.
data_description.sleep_time: When your household typically goes to bed. Climate Advisor switches to your away/sleep temperature at this time.
data_description.briefing_time: When to deliver the daily climate briefing notification with the day's forecast and HVAC plan.
data_description.briefing_notifications_enabled: Send the scheduled daily briefing as a push notification for this zone. Only the first zone defaults to on, so a multi-zone home does not send one copy per zone. You can change this later in Notifications.

error.invalid_notify_service: Must be in domain.service format (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone)
error.setback_must_be_lower: Setback heating temp must be lower than comfort heating temp
error.setback_must_be_higher: Setback cooling temp must be higher than comfort cooling temp
error.zone_name_too_long: Zone name must be 50 characters or fewer
error.whf_entity_shared_zone: This fan is already controlled by another Climate Advisor zone. A whole-house fan can belong to only one zone. Pick a different fan, or remove it from the other zone first.
error.whf_no_sensors_warning: No door or window sensors are selected, so Climate Advisor cannot tell when the house is sealed and will not stop the whole-house fan for it. Submit again to keep this, or add sensors.
error.whf_command_only_warning: Climate Advisor cannot see the fan's real state, so it cannot see or stop a fan it did not start. Submit again to keep this, or add a fan state sensor in Sensors & Fan options.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat already has a Climate Advisor zone configured.

core.title: Core Settings
core.description: Configure the main entities and notification service that Climate Advisor uses.

data_description.weather_entity: The weather integration Climate Advisor uses for forecasts and outdoor conditions.
data_description.climate_entity: The thermostat Climate Advisor will monitor and control.
data_description.notify_service: The Home Assistant notify service for alerts and daily briefings (e.g. notify.mobile_app_yourphone).
data_description.temp_unit: Used for every temperature shown and entered in Climate Advisor. After changing it a reload is needed, and Climate Advisor will prompt you.
data_description.zone_name: The name shown for this zone in the dashboard and device list. Renaming does not change entity IDs.

setpoints.title: Temperature Setpoints
setpoints.description: Configure comfort, setback, and sleep temperature targets.

data_description.comfort_heat: Target temperature when heating and someone is home.
data_description.comfort_cool: Target temperature when cooling and someone is home.
data_description.setback_heat: Lower temperature used when away from home to save energy.
data_description.setback_cool: Higher temperature used when away from home to save energy.
data_description.sleep_heat: Target temperature when heating during sleep hours (when home).
data_description.sleep_cool: Target temperature when cooling during sleep hours (when home).

temperature_sources.title: Temperature Sources
temperature_sources.description: Choose where Climate Advisor reads outdoor and indoor temperature data from.

data_description.outdoor_temp_source: Where to read outside temperature. 'Weather service' uses your weather integration; a dedicated sensor or input helper lets you use a specific entity. Switching back to 'Weather service' removes the chosen entity.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Pick the sensor or input helper that reports outdoor temperature - the source above switches to match automatically. Clear this field to go back to the weather service.
data_description.indoor_temp_source: Where to read inside temperature. 'Climate entity' uses your thermostat's built-in sensor; a dedicated sensor or input helper lets you use a separate entity.
data_description.indoor_temp_entity: Pick the sensor or input helper that reports indoor temperature - the source above switches to match automatically. Clear this field to go back to the thermostat's built-in sensor.
data_description.sleep_indoor_temp_entity: Optional bedroom sensor used for comfort and automation decisions while your sleep schedule is active (the thermal model always uses the primary sensor). Falls back to the primary sensor if unavailable. Leave blank to disable.

sensors.title: Sensors & Fan
sensors.description: Configure door/window sensors and fan control. When a sensor indicates a door or window is open, HVAC will be paused to avoid wasting energy.

data_description.door_window_sensors: Select any binary sensor entities to monitor, including binary sensor groups that bundle multiple sensors together.
data_description.sensor_polarity_inverted: Enable this if your sensors report 'on' when closed and 'off' when open, which is the opposite of the Home Assistant standard.
data_description.sensor_debounce_seconds: How long a door/window sensor's state must hold steady before Climate Advisor reacts to it -- pausing/resuming HVAC, or engaging/exiting natural-ventilation fan control. Prevents brief openings or a flaky sensor bounce from triggering a reaction.
data_description.manual_grace_seconds: How long to wait after you manually adjust the thermostat before Climate Advisor resumes automation.
data_description.automation_grace_seconds: How long to wait after Climate Advisor makes an automated change before allowing another one.
data_description.override_confirm_seconds: Time between system changes and confirmation of manual override. Transient events (thermostat restart, fan cycles) that resolve within this window are ignored automatically. Set to 0 to confirm overrides immediately.
data_description.fan_mode: How to control fans for ventilation. 'Whole house fan' controls a dedicated fan entity. 'HVAC fan' uses the thermostat fan mode.
data_description.hvac_fan_restrict_mode: For humid climates, 'Heat only' skips the HVAC fan for 2 hours after cooling to avoid wet-coil humidity.
data_description.fan_entity: The fan or switch entity to control (only needed for whole house fan mode).
data_description.fan_state_entity: Optional separate sensor to read the physical fan state (for dual-entity whole-house fans). Leave blank to use the Fan Entity for state as well.
data_description.fan_state_feedback: Turn ON if your fan entity or state sensor reports actual motor state (not just the last command sent). Leave OFF if unsure — CA will command the fan to the desired state on each cycle.
data_description.fan_remote_entity: Optional event entity that fires when the physical RF wall remote is pressed (e.g. from the gunkl/quietcool-house-fan firmware). A remote timer selection (1/2/4/8/12 hours) sets the fan override grace duration. Leave blank to disable.
data_description.fan_min_runtime_per_hour: Minutes of fan runtime per hour (0 = disabled, 60 = always on). The cycle is not clock-aligned — it offsets naturally based on when HA started.
data_description.nat_vent_soft_start_enabled: When enabled, the whole-house fan may start at outdoor/indoor temperature parity (not waiting for outdoor to be measurably cooler) once today's outdoor temperature is confirmed past its peak and declining — for air movement and attic/thermal-mass purge, not bulk cooling. On by default; disable if you only want the fan to run once outdoor is measurably cooler than indoor. No humidity/dew-point sensor guards this today.

occupancy.title: Occupancy Awareness
occupancy.description: Configure toggle entities that tell Climate Advisor who is home. All fields are optional — leave blank if you don't use that feature.

data_description.home_toggle_entity: An entity (input_boolean, switch, etc.) that indicates whether someone is home. ON = home, OFF = away.
data_description.home_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're away and OFF when you're home.
data_description.vacation_toggle_entity: An entity that indicates vacation mode. When active, a deeper temperature setback is applied for extended energy savings.
data_description.vacation_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when you're NOT on vacation.
data_description.guest_toggle_entity: An entity that indicates guests are present. Overrides vacation and away modes — comfort temperature is maintained.
data_description.guest_toggle_invert: Enable if your toggle reports ON when guests are NOT present.
data_description.welcome_home_debounce_seconds: Minimum time between welcome home notifications. If you leave and return within this window, the notification is suppressed. Set to 0 to always notify.

schedule.title: Daily Schedule
schedule.description: Set your household schedule so Climate Advisor knows when to warm up, cool down, and send briefings.

data_description.wake_time: When your household typically wakes up. Climate Advisor starts warming or cooling to your comfort temperature before this time.
data_description.sleep_time: When your household typically goes to bed. Climate Advisor switches to your away/sleep temperature at this time.
data_description.briefing_time: When to deliver the daily climate briefing notification with the day's forecast and HVAC plan.

scheduler.title: TOU Scheduler
scheduler.description: Define up to {max} time-of-use cost schedules ({count} currently defined). Climate Advisor automatically pre-cools or pre-heats before a High-cost period using your existing comfort range and learned response rate — there are no temperatures to set here.

data_description.manage: Choose a schedule to edit, or add a new one.

scheduler_edit.title: TOU Scheduler
scheduler_edit.description: No temperature fields — Climate Advisor banks toward your existing comfort range automatically before a High-cost window.

data_description.name: A short name for this time-of-use schedule (e.g. "Summer Peak").
data_description.days: The days of the week this schedule applies to. Select at least one.
data_description.start: When the High-cost period starts. Climate Advisor begins pre-conditioning before this time.
data_description.end: When the High-cost period ends. Must differ from the start time.
data_description.delete_schedule: Turn on and submit to delete this schedule.

notifications.title: Notification Preferences
notifications.description: Choose which notifications you receive and on which channels. Push notifications go to your mobile app; email notifications go via the send_email service.

data_description.briefing_notifications_enabled: On a multi-zone install, only one zone should send the scheduled daily briefing push/email — otherwise you get one copy per zone. Turn this ON for exactly one zone. Manually clicking Send Briefing on the debug tab always sends, even when this is off.
data_description.push_briefing: Send a short TLDR briefing to your phone each morning.
data_description.push_door_window_pause: Send a push notification when HVAC is paused because a door or window has been open too long.
data_description.push_occupancy_home: Send a push notification when someone arrives home and comfort temperature is restored.
data_description.manual_grace_notify: Send a push notification when the manual grace period expires and normal sensor behavior resumes.
data_description.automation_grace_notify: Send a push notification when the automation grace period expires.
data_description.push_entity_health: Send a push notification when a configured entity (thermostat, weather source, sensor, fan, toggle, or notification service) is removed or stops responding.
data_description.email_briefing: Send the full daily briefing via email with complete forecast and plan details.
data_description.email_door_window_pause: Send an email when HVAC is paused due to an open door or window.
data_description.email_grace_expired: Send an email when a grace period expires and normal sensor behavior resumes.
data_description.email_grace_repause: Send an email when HVAC is re-paused because a door/window is still open after grace expired.
data_description.email_occupancy_home: Send an email when someone arrives home.
data_description.email_entity_health: Send an email when a configured entity (thermostat, weather source, sensor, fan, toggle, or notification service) is removed or stops responding.

advanced.title: Learning & Behavior
advanced.description: Configure how Climate Advisor learns from your preferences and balances comfort vs. savings.

data_description.learning_enabled: When enabled, Climate Advisor learns from your manual adjustments and suggests improvements over time.
data_description.adaptive_preheat_enabled: Use learned heating rate to compute pre-heat start time. Requires learning to be enabled.
data_description.adaptive_setback_enabled: Use learned heating/cooling rate to compute maximum safe setback depth. Requires learning to be enabled.
data_description.weather_bias_enabled: Apply a location-specific correction to tomorrow's forecast based on observed forecast accuracy. Requires learning to be enabled.
data_description.min_preheat_minutes: Shortest pre-heat window the system will ever schedule.
data_description.max_preheat_minutes: Longest pre-heat window the system will ever schedule.
data_description.default_preheat_minutes: Pre-heat duration used before enough observations are collected.
data_description.default_tou_lead_minutes: How long before a scheduled high-cost period TOU pre-conditioning starts, used until enough heat/cool cycles are observed to compute your home's actual rate.
data_description.preheat_safety_margin: Multiplier applied to model-computed pre-heat time as a buffer (e.g. 1.2 = 20% extra).
data_description.max_setback_depth_f: Largest overnight setback the adaptive engine may compute.
data_description.comfort_mode_switch_min_interval_s: Minimum wait between routine heat/cool switches, to prevent rapid back-and-forth. A real breach (indoor temp actually past a comfort edge) ignores this wait and switches immediately.
data_description.aggressive_savings: When enabled, Climate Advisor favors energy savings over comfort — for example, tolerating wider temperature swings before heating or cooling runs.
data_description.comfort_deadband_hot_f: On a hot day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a hot day this applies to switching to heating (the cooling side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
data_description.comfort_deadband_warm_f: On a warm day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a warm day this applies to switching to heating (the cooling side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
data_description.comfort_deadband_mild_f: On a mild or off-classified day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. Mild days have no favored side, so this applies to both heat and cool. Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
data_description.comfort_deadband_cool_f: On a cool day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a cool day this applies to switching to cooling (the heating side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
data_description.comfort_deadband_cold_f: On a cold day: how many degrees past a comfort edge the house may go, right after the opposite mode ran (within the Recent Run Window), before the opposite mode is switched on. On a cold day this applies to switching to cooling (the heating side is never delayed). Going further than this switches at once. This is a tolerance, not the distance at which an edge is pre-armed (that is fixed at 2 degrees, or a third of your comfort range if smaller).
data_description.comfort_family_recency_window_min: How long the heat or cool side counts as having "recently run" (equipment that actually ran, or a time-of-use, predicted-ceiling or you-initiated mode change; not every Climate Advisor write). Used by the overshoot tolerance above (a small overshoot inside this window does not flip the thermostat to the opposite mode) and by the predicted-temperature ceiling guard (which waits instead of acting on a predicted overshoot).

classification_thresholds.title: Day-Type Thresholds
classification_thresholds.description: Temperature thresholds Climate Advisor uses to classify each day. Days at or above the Hot threshold run AC; below Cool threshold use heating. Defaults: Hot 85°F (29°C), Warm 75°F (24°C), Mild 60°F (16°C), Cool 45°F (7°C).

data_description.threshold_hot: Days with a forecast high at or above this temperature are classified as Hot (AC mode). Default: 85°F / 29°C.
data_description.threshold_warm: Days with a forecast high at or above this temperature are classified as Warm (windows recommended, no AC). Default: 75°F / 24°C.
data_description.threshold_mild: Days with a forecast high at or above this temperature are classified as Mild (comfortable, windows open). Default: 60°F / 16°C.
data_description.threshold_cool: Days with a forecast high at or above this temperature are classified as Cool (heating light). Below this is Cold (full heating). Default: 45°F / 7°C.

ai_settings.title: AI Settings
ai_settings.description:
Configure Claude AI integration for intelligent analysis and reporting.
API Key Status: {key_status}

data_description.ai_enabled: Master switch for all AI-powered features. When disabled, Climate Advisor uses only its built-in coded logic.
data_description.ai_api_key: Your Anthropic API key. Get one at console.anthropic.com. Leave blank to keep existing key.
data_description.ai_model: Which Claude model to use. Sonnet is recommended for cost/quality balance.
data_description.ai_reasoning_effort: How much reasoning effort Claude uses. Higher = better analysis but more cost.
data_description.ai_max_tokens: Maximum length of AI responses in tokens (256-16384).
data_description.ai_temperature: Controls randomness. 0 = deterministic, 1.0 = most creative. 0.3 recommended.
data_description.ai_monthly_budget: Maximum estimated monthly spend in US dollars. Set to 0 for no limit.
data_description.ai_auto_requests_per_day: Maximum automated AI requests per day (resets at midnight).
data_description.ai_manual_requests_per_day: Maximum user-triggered AI requests per day (resets at midnight).
data_description.ai_investigator_enabled: Enable the investigative agent (requires AI to be enabled). Performs deep cross-source analysis to find incongruities and data issues.
data_description.ai_investigator_requests_per_day: Maximum investigative analysis runs per day. Each investigation uses extended thinking. Resets at midnight.

github_settings.title: GitHub Integration
github_settings.description:
Configure GitHub issue submission for investigation reports.
Current token: {token_status}

data_description.github_token: Token with issues:write scope. Leave blank to keep existing token.
data_description.github_repo: Repository to submit issues to, in owner/repo format, e.g. gunkl/ClimateAdvisor.
